name: aqg-phase-transition
description: Use at phase boundaries after a plan/design doc, a non-trivial implementation, or written tests to emit PLAN_DONE, IMPL_DONE, or TESTS_WRITTEN and return the recommended audit mode. Signal-only; it reads depth from docs/policies/audit-trigger.md, applies dedup/user-signal/safety-floor rules, and leaves the caller to run or skip /audit.

sentence_patterns: I just finished the plan / sketch; before implementation, check whether I should audit
implementation is done; before review, ask whether an external audit is needed
tests are written; before running them, should I do an audit pass first
I just hit plan_done; this change is a production migration, high stakes, and irreversible
Run aqg-phase-transition emit to get recommended audit mode

cli_contract.0: success — phase verdict printed to stdout (markdown by default, JSON with --json)
cli_contract.1: reserved — surfacing blocker in output, not exit code
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args / unknown subcommand

owner_only_actions: Production / migration / branch protection / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates; phase-transition only emits a signal, never calls the audit tool itself (per ADR 2026-05-08-aqg-skill-distribution-boundary-a1.md §5)

cases.prompt: I just finished the plan / sketch — before moving into impl, check whether I should audit
implementation done — before running review, ask whether an external audit is needed
tests are written — before running them, should I do an audit pass first
I just hit plan_done — this change is a prod migration, high stakes and irreversible
Please use /aqg-phase-transition to emit the phase signal and get recommended_audit_mode
